Can’t go fast without a little oil. 

🫒 “Sizzle” Extra Virgin Cooking Oil for roasting & toasting
🫒 “Drizzle” Extra Virgin Finishing Oil for dipping & dressing
🫒 “Frizzle” High Heat Cooking Oil for grilling & frying

FACT: We source our olive oil from two unique olive harvests, both *perfectly* timed for flavor 🫒

Our finishing oil “Drizzle” is made from early-harvest olives, picked before they’re fully ripe. These olives yield a bold & punchy oil that’s made for drizzling, dressing, and adding a big pop of flavor! 

Our cooking oil “Sizzle” is made from peak-harvest olives, picked right at their prime. These olives yield a more mellow-flavored oil that’s perfect for everyday cooking, like roasting or sautéing! 

And because you’re probably wondering… no, we usually don’t use a seesaw 🥲
Yup, you *do* need two Extra Virgin Olive Oils! Get “Sizzle” for cooking & “Drizzle” for finishing — available in both glass & squeeze bottles!!
